notice: DEMO catalogue. Volumes are rough packed-space estimates in cubic feet (outer envelope) and have NOT been measured or verified. Replace before any operational use. Each item has a stable "visualType" that selects its 3D model; optional "visualDimsM": [width, depth, height] in metres overrides the approximate default proportions.

items.name: Sofa set (bundle)
items.note: A bundle counts its parts once. If you also add one of these parts separately, it is not counted twice.

items.name: Bed
items.note: Mattress is listed separately. Choose a dismantled size only if the bed will be taken apart.

items.name: Wardrobe
items.note: Choose a dismantled size only if the wardrobe will be taken apart before loading.

items.name: Bed set (bundle)
items.note: A bundle counts its parts once. If you also add one of these parts separately, it is not counted twice.

items.name: Dining set (bundle)
items.note: A bundle counts its parts once. If you also add one of these parts separately, it is not counted twice.

items.name: Refrigerator
items.note: Volumes use the outer packed size, not the advertised litres.

items.name: LPG gas cylinder
items.note: Gas cylinders are hazardous goods. Confirm with the transport provider whether they can be carried before including them.

items.name: Clothes (packed)
items.note: Counts clothes as packed bags/cartons. Do not add the cartons again.

items.name: Split AC
items.note: Counts the indoor and outdoor units together. Removal and refitting by a technician is usually separate.

items.name: Inverter battery
items.note: Batteries are heavy. Confirm handling with the transport provider.

items.name: Study set (bundle)
items.note: A bundle counts its parts once. If you also add one of these parts separately, it is not counted twice.

items.name: Pooja mandir (wooden)
items.note: Remove and pack idols and lamps separately.

items.name: Upright piano
items.note: Pianos need specialist handling and a manual loading check.

items.name: Aquarium (emptied)
items.note: Drain and empty before the move. Live fish need a separate arrangement.

items.name: Pool / snooker table
items.note: Heavy slate tables are usually dismantled by specialists. Needs a manual check.

items.name: Portable generator
items.note: Must be emptied of fuel. Confirm transport policy with the transport provider.

items.name: Other oversized / awkward item
items.note: Describe it in the quote request so the transport provider can check it.

items.name: Glass panels (crated)
items.note: Glass should be crated and may need a manual check.

items.name: Modular furniture panels (bundle)
items.note: Use this instead of, not in addition to, the assembled item.

dimensionsNote: dimsCm = [width, depth, height] in centimetres: the packed envelope of ONE unit (item plus packing allowance), scaled once to the stated volumeFt3. Planning sizes only, not measured or verified. Dismantled variants list flat "parts" [length, width, thickness] drawn individually; their volumeFt3 includes packing allowance.
